title: Code-Anchored Review Feedback Improves Correctness and Lowers Hosted Editing Cost on Large R Files
abstract: arXiv:2607.12713v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tokens drive the cost and latency of generative AI (GAI) code editing, and correctness decides whether an edit is useful. We study how the format of a reviewer's feedback, a human-AI collaboration (HAIC) channel, impacts both. In a paired experiment on 36 synthetic base-R tasks with seven models, the same requested changes were delivered as a holistic list (control) or as the export of FileMark (treatment). That code-review extension anchors each comment to the code it concerns and quotes it. For the typical task, total tokens changed by -4.2% to +14.7% across models, while output tokens fell by 14.7% (Claude Opus) and 50.5\% (Claude Sonnet). Since an output token costs five times as much as an input token, the hosted cost of an edit on files over 100 lines fell by 20.0% (Opus) and 46.3% (Sonnet). The treatment raised the correct-run share of four of five local models by 24% to 46%. A decomposition experiment places these gains

translated_title: 代码锚定的评审反馈提高正确性并降低大型R文件的托管编辑成本
translated_abstract: 令牌（token）驱动生成式人工智能（GAI）代码编辑的成本与延迟，而正确性决定一次编辑是否有用。我们研究评审者反馈的格式——一条人机协作（HAIC）通道——如何同时影响这两者。在一项针对36个合成基础R任务、涉及七个模型的配对实验中，相同的修改请求以整体列表（对照组）或FileMark导出内容（实验组）的形式提供。该代码评审扩展将每条评论锚定到其涉及的代码并加以引用。对于典型任务，各模型的总令牌数变化范围为-4.2%到+14.7%，而输出令牌数下降了14.7%（Claude Opus）和50.5%（Claude Sonnet）。由于输出令牌的成本是输入令牌的五倍，在超过100行的文件上进行编辑的托管成本下降了20.0%（Opus）和46.3%（Sonnet）。该处理方式使五个本地模型中四个的正确运行比例提高了24%至46%。一项分解实验对这些收益进行了定位分析。
tldr: 研究表明，将代码评审反馈以“代码锚定”格式（每条评论锚定并引用其涉及的代码）而非整体列表形式提供给大模型，可使大型R文件编辑的输出令牌最多减少50.5%、托管成本最多降低46.3%，并显著提升编辑的正确性。
en_tdlr: Delivering code-review feedback in a code-anchored format (FileMark), where each comment is anchored to and quotes the code it concerns, reduces output tokens and hosted editing costs on large R files by up to 50.5% and 46.3% respectively, while improving edit correctness.
